pdf_explanation: The central shaded shape transforms to thicker outer border and thinner inner cross. The patterns on the outer corners also turn inward in the transformed figure.
why: From figure 1 to figure 2, the solid black circle in the middle becomes a thick-bordered circle with a thin cross inside, and the lines in the four corner squares turn to point inward, toward the middle. Doing the same to figure 3, the black square becomes a square with a thick border and a thin cross, and the clock hands in the four circles turn to point inward. Only option 1 shows both changes. Option 2 has the right square, but its clock hands still point outward, so it fails.
trick: When a figure has a centre shape and four corner shapes, check the centre and the corners as two separate changes. Then remove every option that gets even one detail wrong, such as line thickness or direction.
note: PDF answer A fits: inward clock hands plus thick border and thin cross. Option 2 has outward hands, option 3 a thick cross, option 4 a thin border and thick hands, option 5 a thin border and thick cross.
